steps.reason: Confirm the monitoring report was registered by an accredited auditor for this project.
Check whether this project's boundary and monitoring period overlap another registered project.
Check whether identical evidence text was submitted by other projects.
Check whether near-identical evidence text exists in other projects.
Verify whether the claimed 300 tCO2e reduction is plausible for this reforestation methodology.

attestation.explanation: The monitoring report is registered to this project by an accredited auditor, and its boundary does not overlap any other registered project. No copied or near-copied evidence was found, and the claimed 300 tCO2e (about 3.03 tCO2e per hectare over 98.9 ha) falls within the plausible range of 0.5 to 6 tCO2e per hectare for reforestation. The evidence is brief, but nothing in it contradicts the claim, so the full claimed amount is approved.
